mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% signals an accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate exceeding 8.0% indicates labor market deterioration, which typically precedes reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 8.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates broad-based consumer demand weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS does not produce negative 60-day SPX returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a manufacturing contraction regime (INDPRO < 100), the S&P 500 tends to underperform due to reduced corporate profits, resulting in negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO < 100, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A non-farm payrolls increase above 140,000 per month signals a strengthening labor market, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings, which leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS > 140,000.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 1400 thousand units indicate weak residential demand, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 1400.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a broad economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and INDPRO does not produce negative 5-day SPX returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) and high inflation index (CPIAUCSL > 250), the S&P 500 tends to rise due to supportive monetary policy and stable growth, producing positive forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: low rates with high inflation index
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and CPIAUCSL > 250, the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances.
